before: Unavailable symbol-encoded faces take the document text default, paint missing glyphs, and use text-face line metrics.
after: Unavailable symbol-encoded faces stay unresolved. List markers and symbols keep the authored face, layout uses that face's line box and advances, and export paints their Unicode equivalents.
reason: The change affects only local font resolution and measurement. Canonical XML, model offsets, replicated operations, selections, and awareness are unchanged.
